name: Terada Alice
source:
A girl living alone with her mother in the Hopefield apartment complex. Her treatment would be considered "neglect" by anyone with sound judgement.
While she loves BUTA-CHA~, it would seem the financial situation of her household is too severe to allow for anything but $1 shop trinkets.

As she is a half blood born between her Japanese mother and a foreign father, Alice has blonde hair and blue eyes. Because of this, she is an easy target for bullies at school, but due to some bad rumors, it would seem the school doesn't want anything to do with Alice's mother, and they do nothing about the bulling. 

[Edited from the in-game [url=https://i.ibb.co/mb6sJ7n/Captura-de-pantalla-496.png]character profile[/url]]
